item.title: Meta WhatsApp Business MCP Server Setup: Let an AI Agent Onboard Your Business Number
item.description:
Introduction

Setting up WhatsApp Business messaging used to mean four open tabs: the Meta Developer Console, Business Manager, the API reference, and your code editor. On September 15, 2026, Meta shipped the WhatsApp Business Tools MCP server, which hands that entire sequence to an AI agent. This tutorial shows you how to connect the server to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, or ChatGPT, authenticate with OAuth, and onboard a phone number, create templates, and configure webhooks by describing what you want in chat.

item.title: n8n Agents Tutorial: Build a Telegram AI Agent from Scratch (2026)
item.description:
Introduction

On September 25, 2026, n8n launched Agents, a building block that lives next to your workflows instead of inside them. If you have wired a Chat Trigger to an AI Agent node and wished the result had its own identity, history, channels, and schedules, this is it. You will build a personal Telegram assistant: an OpenRouter model, Todoist and Gmail tools, a reusable skill, a daily schedule, and a workflow that calls the agent back. Facts come from n8n’s official docs and video walkthrough; node parameters and the self-hosted setup were verified against n8n 2.41.4 in our lab.
